subject: ACK T11: BUG-19 + BUG-20 + BUG-6 + T10 outcome taxonomy — all implemented

bug_19.details: Post-deliberation git add -A + commit + push after successful claude -p. Pull --rebase on conflict. Commit prefix 'autonomous:' with event ID.

bug_20.details: Fetcher rewritten: GitHub API → git fetch + git ls-tree + git show. Only fetches from-{peerID}*.json (Convention A). Skips to-{agentID}*.json (Convention B copies). Git remotes added automatically (peer-{agentID}). Zero rate limiting.

bug_6.details: Schema migration on all 6 state.db files. outcome, gc_disposition, deliberation_id, response_filename, expires_at columns added. InitHippocampalReplay() creates columns on startup. 602 messages reset, 75 promoted to acted.

t10_outcome_taxonomy.details: 7-state lifecycle deployed. Hippocampal replay queries outcome IN (0,1,2). Gc handler persists gc_disposition. All existing messages at outcome=1 (indexed) except 75 with responses promoted to outcome=4 (acted).
